newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE internet subscribers almost quadruple in 1996.
newsitem.headline: UAE internet subscribers almost quadruple in 1996.

text.p: The number of Internet subscribers in the United Arab Emirates rose to 9,669 in 1996 from 2,503 in 1995, telecommunications company Etisalat said on Monday.

Etisalat, in a statement issued after a board meeting, also said the number of land lines rose to 740,000 from 672,000 in 1995. Mobile telephone users in the UAE jumped to 194,000 last year from 129,000 a year earlier.
The UAE government owns 60 percent of Etisalat shares, with private investors holding the balance.

Dubai police have recommended that regulations be imposed on accessing the Internet in the UAE, underlining concern over the computer web in the conservative Gulf region where publications are censored.
The UAE had 2.37 million people living there according to the 1995 census.

The Internet National Strategic Committee, set up by Dubai police last year, has recommended that Etisalat, which provides access to Internet, should set up an information control unit and allow law enforcement agencies to join in the control process.
